name: Britannia Good Day cashew cookies
ingredients_raw: WHEAT FLOUR, VEGETABLE FAT (PALM), SUGAR, CASHEW BITS (1.8%), INVERT SUGAR, WHOLE MILK POWDER, BUTTER (MILK)(0.7%) AMMONIUM BICARBONATE, SODIUM BICARBONATE (LEAVENING), SALT, SOY LECITHIN MONO & DIGLYCERIDES OF FATTY ACIDS (PALM) & DIACETYL TARTARIC ACID ESTERS OF MONO & DIGLYCERIDES (PALM (EMULSIFIERS), ARTIFICIAL FLAVOURS (NUT, BUTTER, MILK & VANILLA). CONTAINS WHEAT, MILK, CASHEW & SOY MANUFACTURED IN A FACILITY THAT ALSO PROCESSES EGG & TREE NUTS (ALMOND, PISTACHIO).
